## What

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation change.

## Why

Explain the concrete problem and value.

## Ticket

Link the approved issue and cross-repository dependencies. If no issue exists yet, state the approval context; do not invent an issue number.

## Architecture impact

Boundaries, API consumers, schemas/migrations, compatibility, recorded decisions.

## Testing

Commands/results and acceptance evidence. Explain nonapplicable or unavailable checks.

## Screenshots / visual QA when UI

Reference comparison at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390 px, interactive states, keyboard and accessibility evidence; otherwise N/A with reason.

## Security / safety impact

Authorization, privacy, secrets/logs, uploads, uncertainty, model provenance and urgent behavior where affected.

## Risks

Residual limitations, rollout/rollback and dependent PRs.

## Checklist

- [ ] Approved ticket/plan scope only; architecture respected
- [ ] Applicable unit, integration and contract tests pass
- [ ] Applicable E2E, accessibility, responsive and visual QA complete
- [ ] Security/healthcare safety reviewed
- [ ] Applicable lint, format, typecheck and build pass
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility notes updated
- [ ] Required CI passes and findings resolved
- [ ] Targets main; merge requires an authorized decision
